children: Rocket Lab (RKLB) received a Buy rating from Berenberg as the investment bank began coverage of the U.S. and European space industry.

Berenberg expects the global space economy to expand from more than $500 billion in 2025 to above $1 trillion by 2030. The bank sees lower launch costs, rising defense spending and government demand for domestic space capabilities supporting the industry.

Rocket Lab stands out because launch availability remains a constraint. Berenberg views the company as one of the more credible Western alternatives to SpaceX, with its Electron rocket already among the world's most active launch vehicles.

The bigger opportunity could come from Neutron, Rocket Lab's larger rocket designed for higher-value missions. However, the vehicle has yet to reach orbit, leaving development and launch execution as key risks. Competition from SpaceX could also pressure pricing.
Berenberg's Buy rating could support investor sentiment, but Rocket Lab's longer-term upside depends heavily on Neutron's development and successful launches.

title: Rocket Lab Gets Bullish Call From Top Bank as Space Market Could Double
